integrity: Analytic proof is provided; a finite standalone computational verifier is supplementary. No independent scientific review or audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: All-measures minimization is established only for the disease-free SIRVS susceptibility objective and a positive two-level seasonality profile.
The theorem does not characterize the optimal schedule above the pure-pulse cutoff.
The budget is integrated vaccination intensity; individual eligibility, finite pulse capacity, stochastic infection and attack rate are not optimized.
Unindexed general bilinear-control statements remain a possible source of subsumption.
title: Sharp pure-pulse vaccination cutoff for a two-season epidemic
